_comment: Single source of truth for GitHub Secrets usage. Run scripts/audit-secrets-manifest.mjs (wired into code-audit.yml) to detect drift before it reaches production. To add a secret: declare it here AND add it to every workflow that needs it.

SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.description: Supabase service-role key (server-side writes, bypasses RLS)

NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY.description: Supabase anon key (public reads, subject to RLS)

BRIEF_EMAIL.description: Destination address for operational alerts and daily brief

REBRICKABLE_API_KEY.description: Rebrickable API key — set data, images, and catalogue sync

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Google Gemini API key for content generation and captions

BRICKSET_API_KEY.description: Brickset API key — MRP data, set metadata, retirement dates

CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.description: Cloudflare API token — Workers deploy (wrangler) for deploy-cloudflare.yml. Added as a repo secret 2026-09-11 during the Cloudflare Workers migration; never registered in this manifest until now.

GH_DISPATCH_TOKEN.description: GitHub PAT with workflow scope — used to trigger workflow_dispatch from scripts

IG_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Instagram System User access token (60-day, renew by 2026-07-16)

FB_APP_ID.description: Meta app ID (developers.facebook.com app dashboard) — used by ig-token-refresh.yml to exchange IG_ACCESS_TOKEN for a fresh 60-day token

FB_APP_SECRET.description: Meta app secret, paired with FB_APP_ID for the same token-exchange call

ADMIN_PAT.description: Fine-grained PAT, this repo only, 'Secrets: read/write' — GITHUB_TOKEN cannot update repo secrets, so this is what ig-token-refresh.yml uses to write the rotated IG_ACCESS_TOKEN back. Also read-only used by technical-hygiene.yml to check IG_ACCESS_TOKEN's real rotation age (never reads the secret's value).

YOUTUBE_CLIENT_SECRETS.description: YouTube OAuth2 token JSON for Shorts upload. Re-auth via social-automation/youtube_oauth_helper.py. Testing-mode apps expire every 7 days — promote to Production in Google Cloud Console to eliminate expiry.

CONTACT_EMAIL.description: Recipient for /contact form. Server-only, never in client bundle. Enforced by CI guard verify-no-email-in-client-bundle.

GEMINI_SOCIAL_API_KEY.description: Google Gemini API key for VID-P4 video script generation — separate key/quota pool from GEMINI_API_KEY (RADAR/content generation)

GROQ_API_KEY.description: Groq API key — Gemini failover for the article pipeline (groq.ts) and VID-QP/VID-P4's Groq fallback path, plus VID-P4/VID-QP's G10 coherence judge gate (gates.py). Real repo secret since 2026-08-22 (confirmed via `gh secret list`); never added to this manifest until 2026-09-17's audit fix.

ELEVENLABS_API_KEY.description: ElevenLabs TTS API key — VID-P4 voiceover generation

ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID.description: ElevenLabs voice ID used for VID-P4 voiceover generation

CEREBRAS_API_KEY.description: Cerebras Inference API key. Gemini failover in generate-approved-drafts.ts. Free tier supports gpt-oss-120b only — llama-3.3-70b returns 404 on this key (confirmed 2026-06-19). Not exposed to client bundle.

ELEVENLABS_API_KEY_ASMR.description: ElevenLabs TTS/SFX API key scoped to the Quiet Panic (VID-QP) format — separate key/quota pool from ELEVENLABS_API_KEY (VID-P4). Used with voice ID thNHFcPYszCz6ZPG6mUp (Mira Whisper).

MIGRATE_DB_URL.description: ENVIRONMENT secret (not repo-level), set by Abhinav in two environments: staging-migrations (staging pooler URI) and production-migrations (production pooler URI, required reviewer). Connects as postgres (a dedicated migration role isn't possible on Supabase, #404). Used only by db-migrate.yml; never printed.

CI_READONLY_DB_URL.description: Postgres URI for role ci_readonly (SELECT on supabase_migrations.schema_migrations, plus the 4 public-content tables the staging seed copies, migration 20260929200000; plus SELECT on growth.platform_metrics_daily only, migration 20260930070000; read-only, 10s timeout). Password set as a locally computed SCRAM verifier (#400). FP2.3 parity check.

STAGING_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.description: Staging project service-role key (staging project only; never production). In use: the staging Worker build passes it to the Next.js build as SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, because prerendering the sitemap needs it. The build refuses if the key's project ref is the production project. Not to be deleted.

STAGING_SUPABASE_URL.description: Staging project REST URL (FP2.1). Replace after the Sydney staging rebuild (P5 decision 5).

STAGING_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY.description: Staging project publishable key for the keep-alive read (FP2.1). Replace after the Sydney rebuild.

STAGING_DB_URL.description: ENVIRONMENT secret in staging-seed (not repo-level): staging session-pooler URI as postgres. Used only by seed-staging.yml to write the staging content seed (P12, #443); never printed.

BOI_OPS_TOKEN.description: Repository secret used by CI jobs (see required_by). Added to the manifest on 13 Oct 2026.

G19_TERMS.description: Repository secret used by CI jobs (see required_by). Added to the manifest on 13 Oct 2026.
